name: Tea Party Polyphony
desc: Sandrone's specialty. Appearing without fanfare at the tea party is an exquisitely crafted two-tiered assortment of pastries... Could she really have made this herself? Before the surprise in your eyes has time to fade, she folds her arms, turns slightly aside, and lifts her chin. "Hah? What's that look for? They're only tea snacks. Hardly a challenge." A faint, delicate sweetness drifts through the air, as if silently backing up her claim. Well then, best not keep them waiting!

value.text: Decreases all party members' climbing and sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 1500s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).

customize.name: Recipe: Fruity Trio
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Fruity Trio.

customize.name: Fruity Trio
customize.desc: A dessert with a romantic flair. Add jam and fillings made from Bulle Fruit into tart shells and spread some meringue over the top before baking in the oven. The dish offers three fruity aromas all in one bite, making it a top choice for post-meal snacks.

customize.name: Sandrone
customize.desc: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

customize.desc: A pink flower with a pearl-like luster and rich scent profile. It is one of the most important ingredients in a perfumer's arsenal.

customize.name: Bulle Fruit
customize.desc: A fruit that grows in warm and damp environments with ample sunlight. Inside this round and rotund fruit hides a sweet and refreshing surprise.

customize.name: Jam
